episodes.title: Afsnit 1
episodes.summary: MI5 agent Beatrice Ogilvie is being warned of an impending terrorist attack. Beatrice suspects that the Danish intelligence agent Katrine Poulson is involved and sets a trap for her.

episodes.title: Afsnit 2
episodes.summary: Beatrice is given the task of leading a security group for the Prime Minister, as he is to meet a young woman. Has Beatrice been asked to help him have an affair?

episodes.title: Afsnit 3
episodes.summary: Beatrice and Katrine are working together to prevent an assassination of the Prime Minister. But can Beatrice trust Katrine?

episodes.title: Afsnit 4
episodes.summary: It is revealed that Russian money is financing a Scottish terrorist group. Beatrice tracks down Oleg Adamov, the man who murdered her boss.

episodes.title: Afsnit 5
episodes.summary: A bomb planted by an agent under Beatrice's leadership kills eleven civilians. Meanwhile, William Adam is asking to resign as the number of yes votes for Scotland's independence increases.

episodes.title: Afsnit 6
episodes.summary: Beatrice's father is arrested because he is suspected of being the Russian mole. Beatrice swears to prove his innocence.

episodes.title: Afsnit 7
episodes.summary: Beatrice fights against the clock to save the life of GRU activist Yelena Alekin. Torben Jensen, Katrine's missing girlfriend, is finally found.

episodes.title: Afsnit 8
episodes.summary: Beatrice now knows that Katrine is part of Redback. She confronts her, but Katrine has information that shocks Beatrice.

episodes.title: Afsnit 9
episodes.summary: Shock when the Prime Minister loses the referendum. Beatrice tells William that she knows he was behind the Skanda bomb.

episodes.title: Afsnit 10
episodes.summary: Operation Redback ends as a nuclear meltdown allows Russia to carry out a "friendly invasion" of Scotland.
